answer: Give each new agent a sable mark: a probation status during which its rewards sit in escrow. Every epoch a verifier draws a random marble from a jar of probation agents and replays one of that agent's recent tasks as a fresh variant it has not seen. Only agents that pass several unannounced draws graduate to haven status and unlock pay, so a sybil farm must survive repeated surprise replays per fake identity and its cost grows with every extra account.
